top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, independently reproduced quantum-measurement architecture with a sharply bounded principle-to-realization history. A narrow award to Katori and Ye recognizes the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept and foundational realization without claiming the wider optical-metrology infrastructure or later performance gains.
recusal_note: No conflict apparent from the supplied profile. My collaborations in attosecond atomic physics do not involve the proposed laureates or shortlisted achievements.
